label: copy-phase input m late in the sequence, when the output is 1 or m
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and essentially only when the fed-back input is m (1827 of 1828 dev activations). It is also never the first occurrence of m. It does not fire in the original or delimiter phases, never for recall_idx < 3, and almost never for t < 10. The rate rises with t and L (L=9 holds 57% of mass). It fires on only about 2% of copy-phase m inputs. Whether it fires depends mostly on the token being output after m: 1 (55% of mass) or m (27%, i.e. an m m repeat), with smaller tails for j and z. Top activations are the pattern ...m 1... from long sequences, with m at original position 4-6 (e.g. t e t o m 1 j t 1, activation 2.57). The predicate (copy, input m, t >= 12, output 1 or m) gets dev F1 0.56 and mass recall 0.71. Adding recall_idx/to_go conditions does not get F1 above about 0.57. False positives are mostly m m repeats in shorter or earlier positions. Misses are m followed by other tokens (z, h, 1 at earlier t). Precision and recall are both clearly incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=m (+6.71), phase=2 & out_tok=1 (+3.70), next_out=1 (+3.67), in_tok=m (+3.58), out_tok=1 (+3.39), phase=2 & out_tok=m (+2.84). Lower it: prev2_tok=<DEL> (-2.66), recall_idx=2 (-2.66), recall_idx=1 (-2.43), prev_tok=<DEL> (-2.43).
